title: DNS-SD callbacks use undefined fields after a discovery error
summary: Error callbacks use name/domain/full_name although SDK documents those fields undefined on nonzero errorCode. Next: handle error before consuming fields, retain requested resolve context and add ordinary callback-error fixtures.
evidence: indigo_libs/indigo_service_discovery.c:361,402; installed Xcode dns_sd.h Browse1677-1681/Resolve1792-1796 callback contract.
